skill.displayName: Big8 · 算八字·玄学算命助手（八字排盘·算命·风水·面相·星座·每日一卦）| Chinese Fortune Telling, Feng Shui & BaZi

version.changelog: 修复：显示名改为☯ Big8 · 玄学助手

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches its fortune-telling purpose, but it asks users to provide selfies for face reading while making privacy claims that are not fully scoped or verifiable.

dimensions.detail: The capabilities are coherent with the stated purpose: feng shui photo review, face reading, BaZi, zodiac, divination, and almanac output. The main sensitivity is that face reading uses selfies and infers personal traits from facial features.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill directs automatic Vision Model analysis of uploaded images, including selfies, and pure face images can trigger face-reading mode without an explicit pre-analysis consent step.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions, local YAML knowledge files, and one Python helper script. No installer, background worker, or hidden setup mechanism was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local script behavior is limited to date, lunar-calendar, zodiac, divination, and almanac calculations. Fixed Asia/Shanghai time and default male gender are disclosed but can produce inaccurate personalized results for some users.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence or credential use was found in code, but the artifact states photos are not stored or transferred while also relying on Vision Model processing and not specifying provider, retention, or deletion boundaries.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing if you may upload selfies or other personal photos. The skill appears clean from static and VirusTotal telemetry and does not show destructive behavior, but its face-reading feature handles sensitive biometric images and its privacy wording does not clearly explain model provider processing, retention, or deletion.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The privacy assurance in big8-plan.md says face images are not uploaded to third parties, while the design also depends on Vision Model processing. That mismatch is a real disclosure concern, though no exfiltration code was found.
[SQP-3] expected: Using Asia/Shanghai time is disclosed and fits Chinese almanac conventions, but users outside that timezone should know date-based outputs may be wrong.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The BaZi flow defaults unspecified gender to male. This is disclosed, but it is an unnecessary sensitive-attribute assumption that can affect results.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The repeated male-default rule reinforces the same consent and accuracy issue; it does not indicate malware or hidden execution.
[SQP-2] expected: Selfie-based face reading is central to the skill, but the artifact should give clearer biometric/privacy notice before users upload face images.
